title: π-normality reduction dependency graph (the tractability map)
description: Every proved π-frontier claim, its status, and its edges. The graph has a single sink (the open lemma RL) and a single source (the authentic four-pole BBP orbit). A proof-front can read this to know exactly what is available and what a proof of RL would consume.
